Dear Nestlé Recruitment Team,

I am writing to apply for the eCommerce Internship at Nestlé in Brussels, starting February 2027. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content management, and WordPress site building, I am eager to bring my skills to your eCommerce team and learn how digital channels drive growth in the FMCG sector.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and maintain client websites, ensuring product information is accurate and optimised. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across search engines. I am confident with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and currently improving. Based in Zwijndrecht, I am available for the full six-month duration and have the legal right to work in Belgium.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Nestlé's eCommerce footprint and grow within your dynamic team.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the eCommerce Internship at Nestlé, starting February 2027. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content management, I am drawn to Nestlé's commitment to strengthening online presence for iconic brands like Nescafé, KitKat, and Maggi. The opportunity to work across Pure Players and Brick & Mortar retailers, while supporting online-only customers, aligns perfectly with my passion for eCommerce and my desire to learn how digital channels drive growth in the FMCG sector.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content to grow organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites, ensuring content is accurate and optimised. This experience has honed my ability to manage eContent processes, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to guide decisions. On my personal project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits, improving visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. These skills directly translate to uploading and optimising product content across customer platforms, and acting as an E-content specialist.

I am confident with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and enjoy collaborating with others to achieve shared goals. I am proactive, independent, and quick to take ownership of tasks. Fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and currently improving, I am eager to work in a multilingual environment. Based in Zwijndrecht, I am available for the full six-month internship and have the legal right to work in Belgium.

I would be thrilled to contribute to Nestlé's eCommerce team, learn from your experts, and help strengthen online visibility and performance. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
